description: AGENTS.md is a refreshed copy of CLAUDE.md, not a link (ent#819 forbids links in an agent home). Codex and OpenCode refresh it at every turn; a sha256 provenance record decides ours-vs-authored: no file is copied, our stale copy is refreshed, an authored (or author-edited) file is never overwritten, a leftover lilu#257 symlink becomes a copy.
